What is Lipo 360?

Lipo 360 is one of today's most popular body contouring procedures because it treats the entire midsection instead of a single area. By removing stubborn fat from the abdomen, waist, flanks, and lower back, Lipo 360 creates a smoother, more proportionate appearance from every angle.

Unlike traditional liposuction, which often targets one isolated area, Lipo 360 focuses on creating balance and definition around your entire torso. Many patients combine Lipo 360 with procedures such as a tummy tuck or Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) to further enhance their results.
At Tampa Bay Body Sculpting, we provide personalized cosmetic surgery guidance to help you understand your options and confidently navigate your body contouring journey.

Lipo 360 is a comprehensive liposuction procedure that removes unwanted fat from the entire midsection, including the abdomen, waist, flanks, and back. By treating these areas together, Lipo 360 creates a smoother, more balanced, and natural-looking body contour.

Men and women with stubborn fat in the abdomen, waistline, flanks, or lower back who are looking for a more sculpted silhouette may be good candidates for Lipo 360. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and close to their target weight.

Lipo 360 targets multiple areas around the torso in one procedure, including the upper and lower abdomen, love handles (flanks), waist, lower back, bra roll, and mid-back. Treating the entire circumference helps create a more sculpted silhouette.

Yes. Lipo 360 can often be customized to include additional areas based on your anatomy and aesthetic goals. During your consultation, your provider will recommend a personalized treatment plan to help achieve balanced, natural-looking results. Common areas that may be added include: Upper Back, axilla, arms, chin, and also Brazilian Butt Lift BBL.

Most patients experience swelling, bruising, and soreness during the first 1–2 weeks after surgery. Compression garments are typically worn to support healing during recovery and help optimize contouring results.

Lipo 360 can create a slimmer waistline, improve body proportions, remove stubborn fat, and enhance natural curves. Because multiple areas are treated together, patients often achieve a more balanced and comprehensive body contour than with traditional liposuction.

We offer financing options to help make Lipo 360 more affordable. During your consultation, we'll review available payment plans and financing solutions so you can choose the option that best fits your budget.
Results from Lipo 360 can be long-lasting when combined with a stable weight and healthy lifestyle. Once fat cells are removed, they do not return.

First 24 Hours After Lipo360

After body contouring, you may experience mild to moderate discomfort, along with swelling and bruising. You might notice fluid drainage from incision sites and a feeling of tightness in the treated areas. Additionally, fatigue from anesthesia and surgery is common as your body begins the process of stubborn fat removal, ultimately leading to natural-looking results.
First Week of Recovery

Continue light walking throughout the day to support your recovery after body contouring. Stay hydrated to help your body achieve natural-looking results. Focus on consuming protein-rich foods to aid in stubborn fat removal. Avoid strenuous activity during your recovery phase and follow all post-operative instructions provided by your surgical team.
Weeks 2–4

As bruising continues to fade, you'll notice that swelling gradually improves and energy levels start to increase. Walking and light activity become easier, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of body contouring. Over time, the results will reveal a more defined silhouette, showcasing the natural-looking results of stubborn fat removal.
Weeks 4–6
Complete Recovery Guide

Most bruising has disappeared, and the swelling continues to improve, allowing for a more comfortable fit in clothing. As you recover from body contouring, physical activity can gradually increase, leading to more natural-looking results. The effects of stubborn fat removal become increasingly visible over time.
Recovery Tips

Stay hydrated to support your body contouring journey. Wearing compression garments can enhance your recovery and contribute to natural-looking results. Incorporate protein-rich foods into your diet to aid in stubborn fat removal. Make walking a daily habit to promote overall wellness. Always follow your provider's instructions for optimal recovery.
